label: 眠りの月
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent FOUR-frame battle VFX sheet EXACT 2x2 equal cells, order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. clear gold-violet crescent hovering above a low hollow moon seal, sparse downward lavender motes; peaceful NON-damaging spell, no explosion. Frame1 onset at 25% intensity, frame2 energetic expansion, frame3 spectacular maximum impact, frame4 dying fragments. Also design frame4->1 as a smooth subtle pulse for status/residue loop. Refined fantasy JRPG pixel art, chunky crisp clusters and stepped edges, dark defined contour, high contrast, dramatic late-game power. No character, weapon prop, landscape, solid floor, text, labels, grid, checkerboard, watermark, photographic smoke or airbrush. Actual transparent alpha including hollow centers. Each full effect in its own cell with 12% clear padding; no clipping or overlap. Local 0..1024 coordinates: fixed center (512,512), trail points RIGHT for left-moving projectiles. Keep size consistent, only purposeful expansion varies. Palette black/violet/crimson with silver/gold accents.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 三日月と低い月印で無被害の睡眠術を表現。
issues: 月の内側と魔法陣中央に灰色の塗りが見える。中心が透明かを検収する。
最大コマの紫の渦と飛沫が広い。穏やかな状態表示として占有範囲を整理する。
反復時に月・陣の寸法が急に変わらないか確認する。
